title: Art Piece
description: A reusable art piece: wardrobe, hero-signature item, background, hairstyle, motion, expression or gaze. Required content fields depend on kind. Field names are the shared vocabulary in data/art/_schema/field-vocabulary.json -- reuse them, never invent synonyms.

tags.description: Free-form search/ideation tags (e.g. studio, profile, swimwear); never rendered into a prompt.

extends.description: Path of a base piece (data/art/...json) this piece builds on. Its own fields replace the base's; {{BASE}} in a text field is the base's text, a value starting with + is the base's text followed by the rest, negatives are merged. Same kind as the base; no cycles.

includes.description: A set built from other pieces of the same kind (data/art/...json): its description is theirs, joined with '; ', so a jewellery set is a real ring, earring and necklace instead of one pasted sentence. Instead of description (not with it) and not with extends.

vars.description: Fills the [[SLOT]] gaps of the base piece's text (a frame shared by several heroes), e.g. {"SHAPE": "a curved feather"}. Only with extends (a kind "design" piece is the exception: it only carries vars); every slot must be filled.

backgroundRealm.description: A realm piece only: which backgrounds/ folder its scenes draw from, when that is not the realm's own name (fantasy-cinematic uses backgrounds/fantasy).

varsFrom.description: Path of a kind "design" piece whose vars fill this piece's [[SLOT]] gaps, so several pieces of one hero share one set of values; the piece's own vars win.

negatives.description: Feeds a {{<SLOT>_NEG}} token (e.g. a realm's modern-object bans).
